title: Governed Staging readiness execution and verification

phases.objective: Execute an explicitly authorized Staging-only database access repair through the existing signed Recovery ticket authority and finalize it only after canonical same-cycle readback.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A single-use exact-SHA grant-repair ticket is verified and reserved before mutation, the canonical local bootstrap executor runs, same-cycle readback verifies the result, and the durable ticket is finalized; partial or unknown outcomes remain blocked for reconciliation.
steps: Resolve a database.access_repair plan bound to Staging, exact SHA, target, operation, idempotency key, and grant binding.
Verify the server-issued Ed25519 execution ticket through the private Recovery authority.
Atomically reserve the single-use ticket before invoking the repository-owned local bootstrap executor.
Record an immutable partial receipt when mutation outcome is unknown.
Finalize the durable ticket only after canonical same-cycle grant readback succeeds.
assertions: Caller-generated tickets, inline SQL, caller-selected database targets, replay after unknown mutation, and cross-environment authority are rejected.
The private execution transport is not advertised as a Custom GPT action.
The existing BACKEND_API_KEY is reused and no new secret is introduced.
Production deployment, Production database mutation, DNS, Cloudflare, Hostinger and provider mutation remain unauthorized.
Live readiness and Phase B external evidence are not fabricated.

phases.objective: Shared-runtime compatibility is reviewed without granting Production execution.
blockers: Production deployment and mutation require a separate governed release and explicit authorization.
Provider, DNS and Production database mutation are outside this change.
